cohort: 114 women who sustained uterine rupture in the Netherlands between January 1st, 2017 and December 31st, 2019
finding: Nationwide audit of uterine rupture cases identified improvable factors related to communication, documentation, and organization of care, leading to recommendations for improved communication, documentation, and team training.
mod_finding: The majority of women who sustained uterine rupture had given birth by cesarean section in a previous pregnancy (94%).
